subject: Comparing akdes between seasons or time of day

messages.author: 96b7f29d99ff1aca
messages.subject: Comparing akdes between seasons or time of day
parts:
Hi Chris. 

There might be a simple answer to this question. 

Say I want to compare akdes at different time of day (day v night) or season (early v late) for a population of individuals. Do I need to split the the data (by time of day or season) and run seperate ctmm models for each individual based on this seperated dataset (i.e. two movement models for each individual, one a night and one at day), or is there a way that I can make this comparison using the total dataset (i.e. one movement model per individual)?

Hope this makes sense.

messages.author: 9eada87ac9c1c9b2
messages.subject: Re: Comparing akdes between seasons or time of day
parts:
Hello Marcus,

In that case, you'll want to split the dataset for each individual and run separate movement models for the different temporal windows.
